integrity: Proof supplied; reproducibility script is supplementary finite checking, not a proof or independent validation. Earliest motivating source public date verified on arXiv.
scientific_limitations: Scalar Ornstein--Uhlenbeck SDE; continuous even decreasing-tail step policies bounded inside the Euler mean-square stability range; comparison is mesh-point stationary variance at equal invariant mean timestep. The 2026 source motivates the update, but the high-step witnesses need not satisfy all its sufficient regularity assumptions. No assertion about physical-time invariant measure, nonquadratic potentials, total wall-clock cost, or independent verification.
title: A sharp mean-step reversal for adaptive Euler--Maruyama on the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck sampler
